exercises.title: An adjacency list
exercises.task: Read Graph: a map from each node to the list of nodes it points to. Run builds the dependencies of a small system (api -> db means api depends on db) and prints each node's neighbours.

exercises.title: Build the graph
exercises.task: Fill Build: read lines A -> B and add the edge. Every node that appears, even only on the right, must be a key of the graph, with an empty list if it points nowhere.
hints: Make sure B exists as a key too: if _, ok := g[b]; !ok { g[b] = nil }.
Then g[a] = append(g[a], b): appending to a missing key works, it starts from nil.

exercises.title: Deploy first, safe to remove
exercises.task: From the dependency graph, list the services that depend on nothing (they can be deployed first) and the services that nothing depends on (they can be removed without breaking anyone). Both lists sorted.
hints: Depends on nothing: the node's own list is empty.
Nothing depends on it: it never appears in anyone's list. Count the incoming edges (the in-degree) in a map.
sort.Strings before returning: map iteration order is random.
